description: This is a Java source file defining the class 'Tracker', which is used to keep track of generated objects, enums, POJOs, and related references in a code generation context.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A class for tracking generated objects, enums, POJOs, and referenced variables within a code generation process.

methods.name: addGeneratedObject
methods.description: Adds a Generated object to the Tracker's set.

methods.name: getGeneratedObjectForClassName
methods.description: Retrieves a Generated object matching the specified class name.

methods.name: getGeneratedObjectForVarName
methods.description: Retrieves a Generated object matching the specified variable name.

methods.name: addGeneratedEnumType
methods.description: Tracks a new enum type by name.

methods.name: hasGeneratedEnumType
methods.description: Checks if an enum type has already been tracked.

methods.name: addEventReferenceVariable
methods.description: Marks a variable as referenced by events.

methods.name: isVariableReferencedByEvents
methods.description: Checks if a variable is referenced by events.

methods.name: hasGeneratedPojo
methods.description: Determines if a POJO with the given name has been generated.

methods.name: addPojoHeaderFile
methods.description: Associates a header filename with a POJO variable.

methods.name: getPojoHeaderFile
methods.description: Retrieves the header filename associated with a POJO variable.

methods.name: addPojoEncodeFunction
methods.description: Associates an encode function name with a POJO variable.

methods.name: getPojoEncodeFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the encode function name for a POJO variable.

methods.name: addPojoDecodeFunction
methods.description: Associates a decode function name with a POJO variable.

methods.name: getPojoDecodeFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the decode function name for a POJO variable.
